Last Time: Speak Up for Me

1. Explain: What makes an ask strong? Name

2 parts.

you say?

Transitions Level 2 · What Is Independent Living?

Learn

Learn the Word

Independent living means I do my home

jobs myself.

It also means I ask for help the right

way.

Nobody does everything alone.

🧽 Wipe surfaces

🧹 Sweep the floor

👕 Sort and fold laundry

Words to Know

Home words

Sorting words

independent = I do it utensil = a tool to eat

myself

or cook

chore = a job at category = a group

home

that goes together

routine = steps I do organize = put things

the same way in order
